{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Identify QA orders in this group
qa_in_loyal_completed = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders from the analysis
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue on clean data
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of QA orders in LOYAL completed group: {len(qa_in_loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue_clean}")"}
